# 31｜Lesson 31：The Sculptor Speaks

> 📌 **《新概念英语四 · 双语精讲》系列 · 第 31 篇 / 共 48 篇**
> 📖 Lesson 31 · 21 句 · 15 词 · 2 个语法点 · 6 道自测题

## 01 课文精读 · Text

**1. Appreciation of sculpture depends upon the ability to respond to form in 3 dimensions.**

欣赏雕塑取决于能够感知三维形态的能力。

**2. That is perhaps why sculpture has been described as the most difficult of all arts;**

这也许就是为什么雕塑被描述为所有艺术中最难的；

**3. certainly it is more difficult than the arts which involve appreciation of flat forms, shape in only two dimensions.**

当然，它比那些涉及欣赏平面形态（仅二维形状）的艺术要难。

**4. Many more people are 'form-blind' than colour-blind.**

相比色盲，更多的人是“形盲”。

**5. The child learning to see, first distinguishes only two-dimensional shape; it cannot judge distances, depths.**

孩子在学习看东西时，首先只能辨别二维形状；它无法判断距离和深度。

**6. Later, for its personal safety and practical needs, it has to develop (partly by means of touch) the ability to judge roughly 3-dimensonal distances.**

后来，为了自身的安全和实际需要，它必须培养（部分通过触摸）粗略判断三维距离的能力。

**7. But having satisfied the requirements of practical necessity, most people go no further.**

但是，在满足了实际需要的要求之后，大多数人就不会再深入了。

**8. Though they may attain considerable accuracy in the perception of flat form,**

尽管他们可能在感知平面形态方面达到相当高的准确度，

**9. they do not make the further intellectual and emotional effort needed to comprehend form in its full spatial existence.**

但他们不会付出进一步的智力和情感努力，来理解形态的完整空间存在。

**10. This is what the sculptor must do.**

这就是雕塑家必须做的事情。

**11. He must strive continually to think of and use, form in its full spatial completeness.**

他必须不断努力思考和运用形态的完整空间性。

**12. He gets the solid shape as it were, inside his head--he thinks of it, whatever its size, as if he were holding it completely enclosed in the hollow of his hand.**

他仿佛将固体形状置于脑中——无论大小，他都将其视作完全握在掌中。

**13. He mentally visualizes a complex form from all round itself;**

他在脑海中从各个方向观察复杂的形态；

**14. he knows while he looks at one side what the other side is like; he identifies himself with its centre of gravity, its mass, its weight;**

当他看一面时，他就知道另一面是什么样子；他将自己与它的重心、质量、重量联系起来；

**15. he realizes its volume as the space that the shape displaces in the air.**

他将它的体积理解为形状在空气中排开的空间。

**16. And the sensitive observer of sculpture must also learn to feel shape simply as shape, not as description or reminiscence.**

并且，敏感的雕塑观察者也必须学会将形状单纯地感受为形状，而不是描述或回忆。

**17. He must, for example, perceive an egg as a simple single solid shape quite apart from its significance as food,**

例如，他必须将一个鸡蛋视为一个简单、单一的固体形状，完全脱离它作为食物的意义，

**18. or from the literary idea that it will become a bird.**

或脱离它会变成一只鸟的文学观念。

**19. And so with solids such as a shell, a nut, a plum, a pear, a tadpole, a mushroom,**

对于诸如贝壳、坚果、李子、梨、蝌蚪、蘑菇、

**20. a mountain peak, a kidney, a carrot, a tree-trunk, a bird, a bud, a lark, a ladybird, a bulrush, a bone.**

山峰、肾脏、胡萝卜、树干、鸟、花蕾、百灵鸟、瓢虫、香蒲、骨头等固体也是如此。

**21. From these he can go on to appreciate more complex forms or combinations of several forms.**

从这些事物中，他可以进一步欣赏更复杂的形态或多种形态的组合。

## 03 语法精讲 · Grammar

**1. 让步状语从句：though引导的让步结构**

`Though + 从句, 主句`

用来表示虽然存在某个情况，但主句的结果仍然成立，表达让步的逻辑关系

though引导的从句可以放在句首或句中，不与but连用，但可以和yet、still搭配，语气较although更口语化

**例句：Though they may attain considerable accuracy in the perception of flat form, they do not make the further intellectual and emotional effort needed to comprehend form in its full spatial existence.**

虽然他们可能在感知平面形状方面达到相当准确的程度，但他们不会进一步付出智力和情感上的努力，去理解存在于完整空间中的形体。

**2. 被动语态的使用**

`主语 + be + 动词过去分词 + (by + 动作发出者)`

当动作的承受者是句子的主语，或者不需要明确指出动作发出者时，使用被动语态

常用于正式文体中，强调动作的承受者，或者当动作发出者不明确、不重要时使用

**例句：That is perhaps why sculpture has been described as the most difficult of all arts.**

这也许就是为什么雕塑被称作所有艺术中最难的一种。

## 04 句型模仿 · Patterns

- **... depends upon the ability to do sth**
  - 课文原句：Appreciation of sculpture depends upon the ability to respond to form in 3 dimensions.（对雕塑的鉴赏取决于对三维形体做出反应的能力。）
  - 仿写：Learning a foreign language well depends upon the ability to use it in real communication.（学好一门外语取决于在真实交流中使用它的能力。）
- **That is perhaps why + 从句**
  - 课文原句：That is perhaps why sculpture has been described as the most difficult of all arts.（这也许就是为什么雕塑被称作所有艺术中最难的一种。）
  - 仿写：That is perhaps why many people prefer to travel during off-peak seasons.（这也许就是为什么很多人更喜欢在淡季出行。）
- **Sb must learn to do sth, not as sth else.**
  - 课文原句：And the sensitive observer of sculpture must also learn to feel shape simply as shape, not as description or reminiscence.（而敏锐的雕塑观察者也必须学会单纯地把形状当作形状去感受，而不是作为描述或者回忆。）
  - 仿写：A literary critic must learn to analyze a work simply as an independent creation, not as an extension of the author's private life.（文学评论家必须学会单纯把作品当作独立的创作去分析，而不是作为作者私生活的延伸。）

## 06 参考答案 · Answer Key

1. **D. visualize**　—— visualize · /ˈvɪʒuəlaɪz/ · verb · 想象，使可视化。指在脑海中形成清晰的图像或画面
2. **strive**　—— strive · /straɪv/ · verb · 努力，奋斗。强调为了某个目标付出持续的努力，常见搭配strive for sth/strive to do sth
3. **apart from**　—— apart from：表示“除了……之外，撇开……不谈”，既可以表示包含也可以表示排除的含义（撇开价格不谈，这条裙子非常适合你。）
4. **continually**　—— He must strive continually to think of and use, form in its full spatial completeness. — 他…
5. **C. 让步状语从句：though引导的让步结构**　—— 让步状语从句：though引导的让步结构：Though + 从句, 主句：though引导的从句可以放在句首或句中，不与but连用，但可以和yet、still搭配，语气较altho…
6. **B. 尽管他们可能在感知平面形态方面达到相当高的准确度，**　—— Though they may attain considerable accuracy in the perception of flat form, — 尽管他们可能在感知平面…
